text: At Miskatonic University in Arkham, Massachusetts, the medical student Herbert West rents a room from his classmate Dan Cain and turns the basement into a laboratory for [a reagent that brings the dead back|threat|science playing god]. His first proof is Dan's [dead cat Rufus, revived and vicious|images|animals and birds], and soon the two are [sneaking into the morgue to inject a corpse|wrong|disturbing the dead]. When the dean dies and returns in a violent, zombie-like state, the ambitious Dr. Carl Hill moves to [take credit for West's discovery|wants|wealth and ambition].
